### The God of Details
Author: Katie Westenberg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/the-god-of-details-bible-study-minute-march-15-2018.html
Passage: Exodus 25:9
Points:
- God gave Moses remarkably specific and meticulous instructions for constructing the tabernacle.
- These detailed structural commands reveal a God who cares deeply about the specifics of life.
- When facing daunting situations with limited resources, believers can trust God to provide guidance.
- The unchanging Lord gently takes His people by the hand to lead them in unfamiliar territory.

### God's Dwelling Place
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-january-26-11565208.html
Passage: Exodus 25:8
Points:
- God commanded Israel to build a holy sanctuary so that He could live among them.
- The Lord's presence sustained and renewed the tabernacle throughout forty years of desert travel.
- Through Jesus and the Holy Spirit, believers themselves have become God's living temple.
- Rather than fixating on temporary earthly homes, believers are called to set their eyes on eternity.
